comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Item Effect: Ancient Ganador encounter

Basically summons an Ancient Ganador to the Ganador Command Center, instead of waiting for them to appear at random. The item is dropped by all Ancient Ganadors, and is awarded for completing "A Chance Meeting on the Sea of Atlas" and "Dangerous Caribbean" Atlantis story quests -- they can't be repeated, though.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: It looks like this item was removed from Ancient Ganador drops, so the only way to get them is from those quests or if they turn up in cove/CT.
